metadata.hardware_requirements: NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU, Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 ('NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650')

nodes_source.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
nodes_source.description: Traffic data from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China, used to calibrate simulation parameters in SUMO.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The paper states data is available from the corresponding author upon request.

nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations are extracted from the traffic video frames and are reformed as position matrices.
nodes_process.description: Extracts vehicle coordinates (xi, yi) from raw video frames and maps them to a position matrix mt of size X by Y. Signal states are also encoded into the matrix.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, generic tools used but not named, key parameters stated in Table 1.

nodes_process.source_quote: For computation efficiency, down-sampling is introduced before the matrix stack to reduce the input dimensions
nodes_process.description: Stacks N consecutive position matrices to represent temporal dynamics. Down-sampling reduces the resolution to 4 x 512 pixels.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, all parameters stated, though concrete downsampling library is missing.

nodes_process.source_quote: The algorithm for training the ramp metering policy is presented in Algorithm 1.
nodes_process.description: Trains a CNN-based Q-network using experience replay and a target network. Implements multitask learning to predict Q-values, mean speed, and queue length simultaneously.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, all parameters and hardware stated, algorithm fully specified.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator
nodes_process.description: Simulates the trained policy on a real-world freeway model (Qingdao-Huangdao tunnel). Compares performance against no-control and PI-ALINEA baselines.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, tool named, simulation parameters and scenario details fully provided.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 8: Convergence curves for (a) episode reward and (b) mean travel time.
nodes_sink.description: Training convergence curves showing episode reward and mean travel time over 1 million training frames.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Training setup and simulator (SUMO) are specified, but specific random seeds and exact real-world data files are not provided.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 9 presents the Q1 (25%), Q2 (50%), and Q3 (75%) of the travel times in the mainline for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Mainline vehicle travel times (minutes) over a 1-hour simulation period for No Control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Procedure and comparison baselines are well-defined; simulator is open-source; data source is cited but specific slice is not provided.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Table 2 presents mean vehicle travel times in 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_sink.description: Mean vehicle travel times (seconds) for 20 independent simulation runs comparing No controls, PI-ALINEA, and DRL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Detailed per-run results provided; methods for baselines and proposed DRL are specified.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 10 presents the temporal-spatial distribution of the mean speeds along the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Heatmaps of mean speed (m/s) across distance (0-4000m) and time (8:00-9:00) for three control scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Spatial-temporal outcomes are clearly derived from simulation but exact road geometry details for reproduction are partial.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 11 presents the Q1, Q2, and Q3 of the queue lengths at the on-ramp in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Queue length (meters) over time at the on-ramp for three scenarios, showing median and interquartile ranges.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Standard metrics from SUMO simulator; inputs and comparison methods are documented.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 12 presents the mean queue lengths at the on ramp and the red ratios... in each simulation
nodes_sink.description: Scatter plot showing the relationship between queue length and red signal ratio for PI-ALINEA and Deep RL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Derived from the 20 simulation runs; relationship is clearly visualized.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 13 presents the queue lengths at the on-ramp and the occupancy downstream of the merging area
nodes_sink.description: Time-series comparison of occupancy (%) and queue length (m) for PI-ALINEA and Deep RL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Direct output from simulation; correlation coefficients provided.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 14: Downstream volume in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Box plots of downstream traffic volume (veh/h) at 5-minute intervals for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Standard throughput measurement from simulation; clearly supports claims of higher stable flow.
